name: Special port hardware availability
description: Black-market hardware list and buy authorization follow porttype_items

tests.name: Setup: black market hardware tester
Rig: remove stale isolated test port type

data.sql: DELETE FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market';

tests.name: Rig: remove stale isolated test port type
Rig: create isolated black-market port type

data.sql: INSERT INTO porttypes (code, description, can_buy, can_sell, is_stardock, is_black_market) VALUES ('V2_TEST_BLACKMARKET', 'Test-only black market', TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE);

tests.name: Rig: create isolated black-market port

data.sql: INSERT INTO ports (name, sector_id, type, porttype_id) SELECT 'V2 hardware test black market', s.sector_id, 10, pt.porttype_id FROM sectors s CROSS JOIN porttypes pt WHERE pt.code = 'V2_TEST_BLACKMARKET' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ports p WHERE p.sector_id = s.sector_id) ORDER BY s.sector_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Rig: move tester to test port

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market') WHERE player_id = @{black_market_hardware_tester_player_id};

tests.name: Rig: move tester ship to test port

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market') WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{black_market_hardware_tester_player_id});

tests.name: Rig: reset tester hardware capacity for repeatable stock checks

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET holds = 10, shields = 0 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{black_market_hardware_tester_player_id});

tests.name: Rig: allow holds and deny shields in catalogue

data.sql: INSERT INTO porttype_items (porttype_id, hardware_items_id, can_buy, can_sell) SELECT (SELECT porttype_id FROM porttypes WHERE code = 'V2_TEST_BLACKMARKET'), hardware_items_id, (code = 'HOLDS'), FALSE FROM hardware_items WHERE code IN ('HOLDS', 'SHIELDS');

tests.name: Rig: configure stock for mapped hardware

data.sql: INSERT INTO port_hardware_stock (port_id, hardware_items_id, stock_quantity, max_stock, restock_quantity, restock_interval_seconds, next_restock_at) SELECT (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market'), hardware_items_id, 10, 20, 2, 86400, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 day' FROM hardware_items WHERE code = 'HOLDS';

tests.name: Refresh player context at black-market sector
hardware.list identifies special port and configured item
hardware.list discounts full stock without changing base price

data.sql: UPDATE port_hardware_stock SET stock_quantity = max_stock WHERE port_id = (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market') AND hardware_items_id = (SELECT hardware_items_id FROM hardware_items WHERE code = 'HOLDS');

tests.name: hardware.list reports full-stock price and stable base price
Set mapped hardware stock to zero

data.sql: UPDATE port_hardware_stock SET stock_quantity = 0 WHERE port_id = (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market') AND hardware_items_id = (SELECT hardware_items_id FROM hardware_items WHERE code = 'HOLDS');

tests.name: hardware.list price rises at zero stock
hardware.buy refuses empty stock
Restore hardware stock for purchase

data.sql: UPDATE port_hardware_stock SET stock_quantity = 10 WHERE port_id = (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market') AND hardware_items_id = (SELECT hardware_items_id FROM hardware_items WHERE code = 'HOLDS');

tests.name: hardware.buy permits mapped item
Verify purchase consumed exactly one unit

data.sql: SELECT stock_quantity FROM port_hardware_stock WHERE port_id = (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market') AND hardware_items_id = (SELECT hardware_items_id FROM hardware_items WHERE code = 'HOLDS');

tests.name: Make hardware stock eligible for scheduled restock

data.sql: UPDATE port_hardware_stock SET next_restock_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 second' WHERE port_id = (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market') AND hardware_items_id = (SELECT hardware_items_id FROM hardware_items WHERE code = 'HOLDS');

tests.name: Make hardware restock task due

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = 'port_hardware_restock';

tests.name: Wait for port hardware restock cron
Verify scheduled restock adds configured quantity

data.sql: SELECT stock_quantity FROM port_hardware_stock WHERE port_id = (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market') AND hardware_items_id = (SELECT hardware_items_id FROM hardware_items WHERE code = 'HOLDS');

tests.name: hardware.buy rejects unmapped item
Cleanup: remove test port

data.sql: DELETE FROM ports WHERE name = 'V2 hardware test black market';

tests.name: Cleanup: remove isolated test port type
